summary: Caesarstone Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, containing its first quarter 2026 earnings press release. The release reports revenue of $88.7 million, gross margin of 22.3%, and an operating loss of $19.4 million. Management discusses restructuring progress and a target of positive Adjusted EBITDA by Q3 2026. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or tender offer—is announced. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report from a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
